title: [17.0.0-rc.0] REST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action has no type dispatch — flow-typed actions can only hit the script registry (MCP path handles them)
body:
Found upgrading HotCRM to 17.0.0-rc.0 (tag commit `fc156fa4a`).

## Symptom
Invoking a `type:'flow'` action (per spec, dispatches on `target` — `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:226/:248/:693`) through the generic REST action endpoint fails with `Action '<name>' on object '*' not found` (wrapped in the HTTP-200 envelope, see #3913).

## Root cause — path asymmetry
- The **MCP/AI path** implements flow dispatch: `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:538-565` (`// ── flow dispatch ──` → `automation.execute(action.target, …)`, converting `result.success === false` into a throw at `:562`).
- The **REST path** has no action-type branching at all: `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` (217 lines) greps clean of `type`/`flow`; its only execution point is `ql.executeAction(obj, actionName, ctx)` (`:107`), i.e. the script-handler registry.

A REST/SDK caller that faithfully follows the spec ("all non-script types dispatch on target") cannot invoke a flow action through the actions endpoint; they must know to call `POST /api/v1/automation/:target/trigger` themselves (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:146-195`).

## Suggested fix
Port the MCP path's flow-dispatch branch (and the other target-dispatching types where meaningful) into `domains/actions.ts`, or document loudly that the REST actions endpoint is script-only.
